annotations.text:
Legevakt queue — basic design.
The app has no design system, so this commits to one: near-neutral warm canvas, and the five triage colours are the only saturation on screen.
Static mockups, not a clickable prototype.

The three patient values keep role="status" and their aria-labels — the BDD suite finds them by accessible name, and aiFix hands that ARIA snapshot to the agent. Any build of this design must keep them.
Considered and not taken. Kept as a record of what the direction was chosen against, not as live options.
